invariants.rationale: commitTimeline is required to look up commit history, so it should not be null when the method is called.
hoodieWriteConfig is required to obtain configuration parameters and should not be null before executing the method.
Estimated record size should be positive for partitioning and file size estimation to make sense.
A positive file size limit is necessary for partitioning logic that follows.
Thresholds for record size estimation should not be negative for valid calculations.
